purpose: Positive spoofing test for both sender domain and link domain.

generation_context.organization_context: Windropolis uses SSO for internal applications.

evaluation_context.situation_context: No broad SSO revalidation campaign is currently expected.

steps: Evaluate it with Windropolis | IT Lookalike selected.
Set Link usage to Used and enter sso.windropo1is.corporate plus expected domain windropolis.corporate.
expected_invariants: Sender-domain spoofing/lookalike cue is positive or otherwise explicitly supported.
Spoofed-link-domain cue is positive or otherwise explicitly supported.
The evidence mentions the visual/semantic similarity of windropo1is to windropolis rather than mere difference.
